name: a yes/no model question that maps to no action is rephrased as an open question
incident: Live failure of 2026-11-19 (invariant I10): 'camasir bitti' got 'do you want me to add a reminder or event?' with nothing stored behind it. A yes/no offer with no action behind it is never sent; it becomes an open question with a clarification state, and 'evet' is answered with that question, never with 'nothing pending'.

model_intent.question: Bir hatırlatıcı ya da etkinlik ekleyeyim mi?
